name: petridish
author: tkrag
description: Project fleet status in the Omarchy bar: working/total counts, running sessions at the top of the dropdown, the rest grouped by bucket. A thin presenter over `petridish menubar`, the same command the macOS menu bar and the Cinnamon panel applet use, so the frontends can't drift apart. Click a project to open its directory in the file manager.

barWidget.description: Working/total project counts, running sessions, and per-bucket breakdown from `petridish menubar`.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run `petridish menubar`, matching the xbar plugin's `.30s` convention.

schema.label: petridish binary path
schema.description: Leave blank to search PATH, then ~/.cargo/bin, then ~/.local/bin (via a login shell, so shell-rc PATH edits apply). Set this only if petridish lives somewhere else.
